proposed_comments.body:
### Run the recent-placement migration when settings load

**Severity:** `medium`

This PR hides the `BeforePinned` choices, but existing settings files can still contain that enum value. Normalize the loaded model before saving migrations so upgraded users are moved to `AfterPinned` instead of keeping the disabled recent-first behavior.

```suggestion
        var normalizedSettings = _settings.NormalizePinnedCommands();
        normalizedSettings = normalizedSettings.NormalizeRecentCommandsPlacement();
```
